sloka: ध्वजो रथस्य प्रज्ञानम् धूमो ज्ञानम् विभावसोः ।तेषाम् यो नो ध्वजो राज स देवत्वमितो गतः ॥२-६७-३०॥
transliteration: dhvajo rathasya prajñānam dhūmo jñānam vibhāvasoḥ ।teṣām yo no dhvajo rāja sa devatvamito gataḥ ॥2-67-30॥

translations.english: The pennant is an identification for one's chariot. Smoke is a mark of identifying fire. All of us are recognised by the pennant (magnanimity) of the king and such a king has gone to heaven.
